verses.1: On that day, a gate will be opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that they may be forgiven their sins and punished accordingly.
verses.2: And on that day, the Lord’s army will make sure that the names of those who are sad are forgotten from this earth. They will no longer be remembered. And also, the prophets and the spirit of sorrow will be removed from this earth.
verses.3: And it shall be like this: someone will be brought forth, and his father and mother will say to him, “Your children will not live.” For you have spoken falsely in the name of Jehovah. His father and mother will reject him as their son.
verses.4: And on that day, the prophets will be punished by God. None of them will be able to escape punishment. They will not be able to hide their sins from God.
verses.5: And he said, “I am not a prophet. I am not a servant of the land. I am just a man who was given this life by someone in my youth.”
verses.6: And he said to him, “What are these things that are in your hands?” And he replied, “They are the things that I have collected from my beloved ones.”
verses.7: May the evil ones be destroyed by the power of Jehovah’s army. May they be defeated and scattered far away. I will put my hand on those who are evil.
verses.8: And throughout all the land, the name of Jehovah will be proclaimed. In that place, people will be recognized, and those who are righteous will be rewarded. And the threefold blessing will be given there.
verses.9: And I brought the three things into the fire. They weighed the gold and silver as they were supposed to be weighed. It will be called after my name. And I will answer him. “My people!” He will say, “Yahweh, my God.”
